ITEM 1 | Roasted halved or whole small cabbage-like buds, dark green outer leaves with charred, blackened brown edges and caramelized spots, glossy with slight oil sheen, firm and holding shape, about 2-3 cm each, roughly 8 pieces clustered in upper right of plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Mixed fresh salad greens, bright green to dark green leaves with some lighter frilly leaves, lightly dressed with a glossy sheen, soft and limp in places, covering the lower left quadrant of the plate about 10 cm across, with thin orange shreds scattered through | 60
ITEM 3 | Thin orange carrot shreds, matchstick-like, bright orange, scattered among the greens, raw and crisp | 5
ITEM 4 | Dark brown glossy dressing or glaze residue, sticky-looking, clinging to some charred sprouts and greens in the center of the salad, small amount | 8
